```{r}
#| label: survey-gender
#| include: false


survey_gender <- readr::read_rds(
  here::here("survey", "survey_gender_conditions.rds")
)
# colnames(survey_gender)

survey_gender_wide <- survey_gender |>
  filter(variable %in% c("ChildSexBirth", "ChildGenderCurrent")) |>
  select(child_id, variable, string_response) |>
  group_by(child_id, variable) |>
  # keep non-NA if available, otherwise NA
  summarise(string_response = na.omit(string_response) |> unique() |> 
              (\(x) if(length(x) == 1) x else NA_character_)(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = string_response) |>
  rename(sex = ChildSexBirth, 
         gender = ChildGenderCurrent)
```


```{r}
# distributions
table(survey_gender_wide$sex, useNA = "always")
table(survey_gender_wide$gender, useNA = "always")
```


```{r}

# do any child_ids from survey match user_ids in your main data?
sum(survey_gender_wide$child_id %in% mrot_df$user_id)
sum(survey_gender_wide$child_id %in% mrot_rt_trial_no_retest$user_id)
```



```{r}
de_sex <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("demographics_data","all_Leipzig_participants_nonames.xlsx")) |>
  mutate(sex_demo = recode_values(sex, "m" ~ "Male", "f" ~ "Female"))


# number of DE users
n_distinct(mrot_df$user_id[mrot_df$site == "pilot_mpieva_de"])

# number overlapping with data
length(intersect(de_sex$user_id, mrot_df$user_id))

# number overlapping with surveys
length(intersect(de_sex$user_id, survey_gender_wide$child_id))

sex_data <- full_join(de_sex, 
          rename(survey_gender_wide, sex_survey = sex), 
          by = c("user_id" = "child_id"))

sex_data |>
  filter_out(is.na(sex_survey) | is.na(sex_demo)) |>
  filter(sex_demo != sex_survey)


sex_data_cleaned <- sex_data |>
  filter_out(sex_demo != sex_survey) |>
  transmute(user_id = user_id,
    sex = ifelse(is.na(sex_survey), sex_demo, sex_survey))
```









```{r}
mrot_rt_trial_no_retest |> 
  distinct(user_id) |> 
  nrow()

mrot_rt_trial_no_retest |>
  left_join(sex_data_cleaned) |>
  distinct(user_id, site, sex) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_with_sex = sum(!is.na(sex)),
    pct = round(100 * n_with_sex / n_total, 1)
  )
```



```{r}
mrot_df_gender <- inner_join(mrot_df, survey_gender_wide, 
                             by = c("user_id" = "child_id")) |>
  filter_out(is.na(sex)) |>


ggplot(mrot_df_gender, aes(x = age, y = metric_value, colour = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(group = user_id), alpha = .3) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  # scale_colour_manual(values = site_pal_labelled) +
  labs(
    x      = "Age (years)",
    y      = "Ability (θ)",
    colour = "Sex"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~site) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
sex_mod <- lmer(metric_value ~ age * sex + (1 | user_id) + (age * sex | site),
  data = mrot_df_gender)

summary(sex_mod)

library(brms)
sex_mod_bayes <- brm(metric_value ~ age * sex + (1 | user_id) + (age * sex | site),
  data = mrot_df_gender)
```





```{r}
#| label: gender-ca
#| include: false

demographics_ca <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("demographics_data", "LEVANTE Demographics Western University (By Child).xlsx"))

# check dimensions and first few column names
dim(demographics_ca)
colnames(demographics_ca)

# look at the first few rows
head(demographics_ca, 3)

# check unique values across all Q columns
demographics_ca |>
  select(starts_with("Q")) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), \(x) paste(unique(na.omit(x)), collapse = " | "))) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "unique_values") |>
  filter(str_detect(unique_values, regex("male|female|boy|girl|man|woman", ignore_case = TRUE)))

# extract q3 and join
demographics_ca_gender <- demographics_ca |>
  select(child_id = `Child ID`, sex_birth_ca = `Q3...20`) |>
  filter(!is.na(sex_birth_ca))

# check distribution
table(demographics_ca_gender$sex_birth_ca, useNA = "always")

# check ID overlap with your main data
sum(demographics_ca_gender$child_id %in% mrot_rt_trial_no_retest$user_id)

demographics_ca_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  here::here("demographics_data", "LEVANTE Demographics Western University (By Child).xlsx"),
  n_max = 2 
)

```
